title: Unit Review: Academic Argument & Precision
goal: Review the academic argument, the perfect infinitive, noun phrases, precise restating and qualified claims.

items: I can build a short academic argument with a thesis, a concession, a rebuttal and a conclusion.
I can write compactly with the perfect infinitive and with noun phrases.
I can restate, define and qualify a claim with precision.
